actions.label: T13 practical slice
actions.expected: All five run scopes are inspect-first and one explicitly permitted offline job is durable.
actions.actual: Batch, Node, Branch, Downstream, and Selected previews were reviewed with their exact Batch-expanded call counts; only the final two-call fake-local Node plan started and completed with two accepted work items and two attempts.
